items.source: factoryType - the interface or abstract class representing the factory
items.translation: factoryType - 代表工厂的接口或抽象类

items.source: The returned factories are sorted using AnnotationAwareOrderComparator.
items.translation: 返回的工厂使用 `AnnotationAwareOrderComparator` 进行排序。

items.source:
If duplicate implementation class names are discovered for a given factory
type, only one instance of the duplicated implementation type will be instantiated.
items.translation: 如果为给定的工厂类型发现重复的实现类名，则仅会实例化一个重复实现类型的实例。

items.source: IllegalArgumentException - if any factory implementation class cannot be loaded or if an error occurs while instantiating any factory
items.translation: IllegalArgumentException - 如果无法加载任何工厂实现类，或在实例化任何工厂时发生错误。

items.source:
For any factory implementation class that cannot be loaded or error that
occurs while instantiating it, the given failure handler is called.
items.translation: 对于任何无法加载的工厂实现类或在实例化其时发生的错误，将调用给定的失败处理器。

items.source: Create a SpringFactoriesLoader instance that will load and instantiate the factory implementations from "META-INF/spring.factories", using the default class loader.
items.translation: 创建一个SpringFactoriesLoader实例，该实例将使用默认类加载器从"META-INF/spring.factories"加载并实例化工厂实现。

items.source: Create a SpringFactoriesLoader instance that will load and instantiate the factory implementations from "META-INF/spring.factories", using the given class loader.
items.translation: 创建一个 `SpringFactoriesLoader` 实例，用于使用给定的类加载器从 `"META-INF/spring.factories"` 加载并实例化工厂实现。

items.source: as of 6.0 in favor of load(Class, ArgumentResolver, FailureHandler)

items.source: classLoader - the ClassLoader to use for loading resources; can be null to use the default
items.translation: classLoader - 用于加载资源的类加载器；可以设为 null 以使用默认值。

items.translation: failureHandler - 用于处理工厂实例化失败的策略

items.translation: resourceLocation - 用于查找工厂的资源位置

items.source: For more advanced factory loading with SpringFactoriesLoader.ArgumentResolver or SpringFactoriesLoader.FailureHandler support, use forDefaultResourceLocation(ClassLoader) to obtain a SpringFactoriesLoader instance.
items.translation: 对于使用 SpringFactoriesLoader.ArgumentResolver 或 SpringFactoriesLoader.FailureHandler 支持的高级工厂加载，请使用 forDefaultResourceLocation(ClassLoader) 来获取一个 SpringFactoriesLoader 实例。

items.source: SpringFactoriesLoader loads and instantiates factories of a given type from "META-INF/spring.factories" files which may be present in multiple JAR files in the classpath. The spring.factories file must be in Properties format, where the key is the fully qualified name of the interface or abstract class, and the value is a comma-separated list of implementation class names. items.source: If a custom instantiation strategy is required, use load(...) with a custom ArgumentResolver and/or FailureHandler.
items.translation: 如果需要自定义实例化策略，请使用 load(...) 配合自定义的 ArgumentResolver 和/或 FailureHandler。

items.source: If the resolvable constructor has arguments, a suitable ArgumentResolver should be provided. To customize how instantiation failures are handled, consider providing a FailureHandler.
items.translation: 如果可解析的构造函数具有参数，则应提供一个合适的ArgumentResolver。若要自定义如何处理实例化失败，请考虑提供一个FailureHandler。

items.source:
If a particular implementation class name is discovered more than once
for the given factory type, duplicates will be ignored.
items.translation: 如果为给定的工厂类型发现多次出现某个特定的实现类名，则将忽略重复项。

items.source: Load and instantiate the factory implementations of the given type from "META-INF/spring.factories", using the configured class loader and a default argument resolver that expects a no-arg constructor.
items.translation: 从 `"META-INF/spring.factories"` 加载并实例化给定类型的工厂实现，使用配置好的类加载器和一个期望无参构造器的默认参数解析器。
